# ResQ Tyres & Recovery

> 24/7 mobile tyre fitting and puncture repair in Leeds and across West Yorkshire.
> We come to the vehicle — home, workplace or roadside — with brand-new tyres on board.
> There is no shop or depot to visit; the service is mobile only.

## What we do

- Mobile tyre replacement: new tyres brought to you and fitted on site.
- Puncture repair, where the tyre can be safely repaired. From £70, up to £120 depending
  on distance and tyre size.
- 24-hour emergency tyre call-out, 365 days a year including bank holidays.
- Planned tyre fitting at home or at work, at the same price as in-store.
- On-site wheel balancing and valve replacement.
- Locking wheel-nut removal — we carry the specialist tools.

## What we do not do

- Wheel alignment. We do not offer it.
- Fitting at a garage, shop or depot. There is no premises to visit.
- Vehicle recovery. "Recovery" appears in the registered trading name only; the services
  offered are the ones listed above.
- Bradford (BD postcodes) is outside the coverage area.

## Coverage

Confirmed postcode districts, and only these:

- All Leeds districts: LS1 to LS29, including LS24 (Tadcaster).
- Harrogate: HG1, HG2, HG3.
- Wakefield, Castleford, Pontefract and Dewsbury: WF1, WF2, WF3, WF4, WF5, WF8, WF10,
  WF12, WF13.

Towns named on the site: Leeds, Wakefield, Dewsbury, Pudsey, Morley, Castleford,
Garforth, Pontefract, Harrogate, Tadcaster.

Outside those districts, call and ask — it may still be possible to reach you.

## Hours

Open 24 hours, 7 days a week, including bank holidays.

## Prices and payment

Fitted tyre prices vary by tyre size. The price guide at
https://www.resqtyres.co.uk/#estimate gives a range, and the exact price is confirmed by
phone before any work starts. Mobile fitting is included in the price, not charged as an
extra. 30% off when all four tyres are changed, subject to availability. No deposit and
no online payment — payment is on completion, by card or cash.
